2608.19072.title: What is Missing from AI Post-Training AI: An Empirical Analysis
2608.19072.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can now post-train an LLM end-to-end. They can write code, launch training, evaluate checkpoints, and improve downstream performance, raising the prospect of AI-for-AI. We argue that this picture conflates two distinct capabilities: execution-level capability, iterating within a selected training strategy; and strategy-level capability, revising the high-level judgment as experimental evidence accumulates. Analyzing a large corpus of publicly released post-training trajectories, we find that across different tasks, the agent's training strategy is locked in at the very beginning, and the entire remaining budget is spent on local adjustments within the selected strategy. We then examine three natural explanations--missing experience, missing guidance, and insufficient reasoning--with escalating interventions. Extensive experiments show that (1) an experience-driven scaffold improves execution across the board (+12.6 points on GSM8K and +40.8 on HumanEval) but leaves the strategy static; (2) human guidance effectively redirects the initial strategy, yet the agent falls back into local adjustment loops once training starts; and (3) additional inference compute pays off on easier tasks but yields almost no gain on the hardest one. In conclusion, what agents lack is neither experience, guidance, nor reasoning compute, but a mechanism for spontaneously reevaluating their strategy during execution.
2608.19072.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理現在可以對LLM進行端到端的後訓練。<lb/>它們可以編寫代碼、啟動訓練、評估檢查點並改善下游性能，這提高了AI為AI的前景。<lb/>我們認為這種情況混淆了兩種不同的能力：執行層級能力，在選定的訓練策略內進行迭代；以及策略層級能力，隨著實驗證據的累積修訂高層次判斷。<lb/>通過分析大量公開發布的後訓練軌跡，我們發現，在不同任務中，代理的訓練策略在一開始就被鎖定，整個剩餘預算都用於在選定策略內的局部調整。<lb/>然後我們檢查了三種自然解釋——缺乏經驗、缺乏指導和推理不足——並進行了逐步干預。<lb/>大量實驗顯示：（1）以經驗為驅動的支架在各方面提高了執行效果（GSM8K提高了12.6分，HumanEval提高了40.8分），但策略保持靜態；（2）人類指導有效地重新引導了初始策略，但一旦訓練開始，代理又回到了局部調整循環；（3）額外的推理計算在較簡單的任務上有回報，但在最困難的任務上幾乎沒有收益。<lb/>總之，代理所缺乏的既不是經驗、指導，也不是推理計算，而是在執行過程中自發重新評估其策略的機制。
